observations: Two solar panels leaning against a wall.
The panels have silver aluminum frames.
The front surface consists of dark photovoltaic cells.
A watermark 'IZUTECH SOLAR ENERGY' is visible across the center of the image.
The background shows a concrete floor and a motorcycle wheel.

claims.claim: Izutech solar energy specialize in all solar equipment
Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The panels may be low wattage (e.g., 100W) or damaged.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification label on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panels may have micro-cracks or hot spots.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) in direct sunlight.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional or for parts

risks.risk: The panels may be used and have degraded output.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading the Short Circuit Current (Isc) in direct sunlight.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used panels needing replacement

proof_requests: Photo of the specification label on the back of the panel showing the wattage.
Video of a multimeter test showing the voltage and current in sunlight.
Photo of the other panel to confirm both are in the same condition.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
